title: Prerequisite Flag Orchestration
description: Interactive D3 dependency graph — toggle a flag and watch prerequisite dependencies cascade across a multi-team checkout release.
longDescription: An interactive dependency-graph visualizer showing how prerequisite flags coordinate multi-team releases. Toggle a flag and watch dependencies cascade live — blocked / ready / active states with colored links for broken dependencies. It models a realistic checkout release across Core API, Web Experience, and a master release gate: the gate can't open until every upstream component is verified.

Runs in simulation mode with no LaunchDarkly account, or in live mode with bidirectional sync — toggle in the graph and see the LD dashboard update, or toggle in LD and watch the graph react. Includes a mock "VERDE+" storefront with flag-driven UI, observability, and session replay.
Run it locally with npm start (deployable to Vercel). Live mode needs a server SDK key + API token; npm run setup-flags auto-creates the six demo flags with their prerequisite relationships.
